subject: Help with Shiny APP using environment variables

messages.author: 2b853c1c7b93d5ca
messages.subject: Help with Shiny APP using environment variables
parts:
Dears,

I have just tried to deploy a Shiny App which uses several environment variables.
One of them catch all the data frame names to show through a select input.

However, every time I lauch this App, the R session show me an error related to this environment variables.

Locally, the APP is running pretty well.

Does Shiny App IO has some problem with environment variables?

See more details:

att <<- colnames(get(dfs[1])) # this instructions receive the folow mensage:

Erro em get(dfs[1]) : objet 'NA' hot found Calls: local ... withVisible -> eval -> eval -> colnames -> is.data.frame -> get

Such instruction is preceded by:
 
obj <- ls(envir=.GlobalEnv)
tmp <- sapply(obj, function(x) inherits(get(x, envir=.GlobalEnv), c("data.frame")))
dfs <- obj[tmp]

Thanks, Marcelo

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Help with Shiny APP using environment variables
parts:
I'm not aware of any issue with environment variables on shinyapps.io (it is just a R process after all).

Could be be there is a problem loading you .RData file?

Have you checked the output of 'shinyapps::showLogs()'?

-Andy
